description: dryvist/.github nix preset. Nix repos extend `local>dryvist/.github:renovate-nix` to get the full org default policy. As of 2026-08-05 it no longer enables Renovate's native `nix` manager — the preset now exists to DOCUMENT why that manager is off and to keep one stable extends target for nix repos.

WHY THE MANAGER IS OFF: flake.lock has exactly one writer, the _update-flake-lock.yml reusable workflow in this repo. It runs a bare `nix flake update` onto the single branch `chore/flake-lock` on a weekly schedule, on repository_dispatch from an upstream release, and on demand — so every flake change for a repo lands in ONE pull request. A second writer would break that guarantee, which is the entire point of the design.

THIS IS NOT A REGRESSION IN COVERAGE. Measured 2026-08-05 across nix-darwin, nix-ai, nix-home and nix-devenv: the nix manager had opened ZERO flake pull requests. Every renovate[bot] PR in those repos came from the github-actions manager. The manager could never advance a channel pin at all (Renovate bumps an input when its REFERENCE changes, and a channel branch's reference never changes), and the digest-tracked inputs it could bump — devenv, git-hooks, treefmt-nix — are now covered by the whole-lock relock.

The `.nix` version-pin customManager (fetchPypi/fetchurl pins carrying a `# renovate:` annotation) is a SEPARATE mechanism defined in the default preset and is unaffected — it edits version strings inside .nix files, never flake.lock.
